title: Seoul police send 52 people to prosecutors over fake plastic-surgery reviews posted with hacked portal accounts
date_note: Date of the Financial News article reporting the Seoul police announcement; the page gives no earlier day.
geo_basis: Seoul Metropolitan Police Agency cyber investigation unit
summary: Financial News reports that Seoul police's cyber investigation unit sent 52 people to prosecutors, including staff of four plastic-surgery clinics, over fake reviews. Police say they bought 800 or so hijacked portal accounts from a Chinese hacking group and posted 8,400 or so posts and comments. Police say the group sold the accounts via Telegram from Qingdao.
plain: Seoul police say 52 people, including clinic and ad-agency staff, were sent to prosecutors over fake reviews posted using about 800 hijacked portal accounts.
exec: Police say clinics and ad firms bought 800 or so hijacked portal accounts to post 8,400 or so fake reviews and comments.

evidence.quote: 성형외과 4곳과 광고대행사 1곳, 직영 광고업체 2곳, 해킹조직 관계자 등 총 52명을 검거해 송치했다.
타인 명의 포털 계정 800여개를 구매해 허위 후기 광고에 활용한 혐의를 받는다.
확보한 계정은 성형 관련 온라인 카페와 미용·의료 정보 플랫폼 등에 허위 후기와 댓글 8,400여 건을 게시하고 특정 게시물을 상위에 노출하는 데 사용됐다.

validation.note: Two independent publishers, Financial News (fnnews.com) and Daily Security (dailysecu.com), each report the police statement: 52 people sent to prosecutors, about 800 accounts, about 8,400 posts. The police release itself was not read.

review.note: figure qualifiers about 800 and about 8,400; removed unsourced claim from exec
